caption_L1: This area plot is named Number of people employed in the coal mining industry in the United Kingdom (UK) from 1920 to 2019 (in 1,000s). The y-axis measures Employees in thousands while the x-axis plots Year.
caption_L2L3: The number of employees employed in the coal mining industry has drastically fallen between 1920 and 2000.  There were steep drops just after 1920 and again after 1960 with gradual falls during other periods.  At no point did the number of employees increase.
